summary: Trivial wrapper that calls TLSValueRetrievalWithInit() and returns the resulting pointer advanced by 2 DWORD units (8 bytes). Its many file- and math-oriented callers use the result as a base from which to reach offset slots, consistent with the TLS_Offset_Getter ABI lead.

operations.description: Invoke TLSValueRetrievalWithInit to obtain the TLS base pointer.
Advance the returned pointer by 2 DWORD units.

unresolved: The meaning of the +2 DWORD offset (which TLS slot it selects) is not determinable from this packet alone.
The internals of the callee TLSValueRetrievalWithInit (init semantics, failure behavior) are outside this function's evidence.
